DeepCool AK400 BK High Performance CPU Air Cooler – Reliable Cooling with a Sleek Black Design

Boost your PC's cooling performance with the DeepCool AK400 BK, a high-performance air cooler engineered for optimal heat dissipation and silent operation. Designed with a powerful 120mm FDB fan and a dense fin-stack array, the AK400 BK ensures efficient airflow and rapid heat transfer to keep your CPU running at peak performance. Its all-black stealth design complements modern PC builds, making it an ideal choice for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts.

Compatible with the latest Intel (LGA1700/1200/115X) and AMD (AM5/AM4) sockets, this cooler offers broad platform support and easy installation. With a maximum noise level of just 29 dB(A), the AK400 BK delivers a perfect balance of performance and quiet operation.


Key Features:

  • Sleek all-black design for a clean, modern look
  • High-efficiency 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing fan
  • Up to 66.47 CFM airflow for superior thermal performance
  • Low noise output for a silent computing experience
  • Wide socket compatibility including Intel LGA1700 and AMD AM5
  • Easy-to-install mounting system
